t: What Music Accessibility Database Is All About
title: What Music Accessibility Database Is All About
description: Music accessibility is sound for all: captions (the lyrics: the d/Deaf), visualizations (the seen beat), haptic (the felt bass: the vest), Braille scores (the touched), and the signed (the interpreted concerts). The tech: vibrating floors, visual EQs. The principle: music is vibration — felt by all. Include every listener. This database is the complete music accessibility record: full records with definitions, key facts, procedures, and runnable demo programs, organized on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced.
